'''Varlo Brim''' was a professional [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal arsonist who was officially blamed for the destruction of [[Grid 19]] of the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]]. There was some suspicion of a conspiracy regarding the fire as Brim was found [[Death/Legends|dead]] of 'natural causes' in his cube almost immediately afterward in an unlikely coincidence. The cause of death was listed as [[Heart/Legends|heart]] failure, which was entered onto his death certificate before the body had arrived at the morgue. Furthermore there was no detailed examination of the corpse.
